findings.statement: Scope: the run record (run:72cf0e4b91a3) is a bounded replay of 55 events. clink exited with status 0, 3 of 3 jobs completed, and the run was not cancelled. Parameters: fan_in_min_senders=5, fan_in_window_ms=3600000, onward_max_gap_ms=1800000. The graph holds 55 transfers, 48 accounts, 35 devices, 14 onward links and 2 fan-in alerts. Everything below holds only for this dataset as processed by this run.

Alert fan_in:A-9278:1794301200000: account A-9278, window 1794301200000–1794304800000. 6 distinct senders, 6 transfers, total 357000 minor units. Contributing transfers: T0002 (A-4452, 42000), T0003 (A-4366, 61500), T0006 (A-7266, 38000), T0010 (A-8133, 89000), T0011 (A-6801, 50500) and T0012 (A-3881, 76000). Each was sent from a different device.

Alert fan_in:A-9895:1794319200000: account A-9895, window 1794319200000–1794322800000. 6 distinct senders, 6 transfers, total 15000 minor units. Contributing transfers: T0035 to T0040, each exactly 2500, from A-8770, A-4399, A-4792, A-9088, A-8060 and A-8166. Each was sent from a different device.

Onward links for A-9278: all 6 contributing transfers are passed on, at most 3 links deep, along A-9278 -> A-5092 -> A-2897 -> A-4989, in two waves. Wave 1: T0002, T0003 and T0006 link to T0007 (A-9278 to A-5092, 138000), then T0008 (A-5092 to A-2897, 135000), then T0009 (A-2897 to A-4989, 132000). Wave 2: T0010, T0011 and T0012 link to T0014 (A-9278 to A-5092, 210000), then T0015 (A-5092 to A-2897, 206000), then T0016 (A-2897 to A-4989, 202000). Neither T0009 nor T0016 is passed on, so the money comes to rest at A-4989 only. Each hop pays out a little less than it received.

Onward links for A-9895: only 3 of the 6 contributing transfers (T0038, T0039, T0040) are passed on, each by one link to T0041 (A-9895 to A-1415, 14000). T0035, T0036 and T0037 are not passed on; their credit-to-debit gaps to T0041 exceed the 1800000 ms limit. T0041 is not passed on either, so the most links in any chain is 1 and the money comes to rest at A-1415. A-1415's later send T0055 is not recorded as an onward link of T0041.

Shared devices on A-9278's routes: device D-568 sent every route transfer from A-9278 (T0007, T0014), A-5092 (T0008, T0015) and A-2897 (T0009, T0016). Those are exactly the three route accounts that sent from D-568; A-4989 sent nothing in the dataset. None of the six senders of the contributing transfers uses a shared device.

Shared devices on A-9895's routes: no device was used by two or more of its route accounts (A-9895, A-1415). A-9895 sent T0041 from D-699 and A-1415 sent T0055 from D-785. The only other shared device in the dataset, D-619 (A-2952, A-9652), is not on either alert's routes.

What tells the alerts apart: as indicators they match (6 senders, 6 transfers, one hour each). The recorded relationships differ. (a) A-9278's chains are 3 links deep and pass through two intermediate accounts to one resting account; A-9895's chains are 1 link deep and go straight to A-1415. (b) All of A-9278's contributing transfers are passed on, but only half of A-9895's are. (c) The three accounts moving money along A-9278's route all sent from one device, D-568; A-9895's route has no shared device. (d) A-9278 received 357000 in varied amounts; A-9895 received 15000 in identical 2500 amounts. Only A-9278's alert combines layered onward movement with a common device across the route, so it calls for closer review. A-9895's alert, seen through these relationships alone, shows a shallow single pass-on.
The accounts where money comes to rest (A-4989, A-1415) and the intermediaries A-5092 and A-2897 have no fan-in alert of their own.

hypotheses.statement: D-568 being used to send from A-9278, A-5092 and A-2897 may mean one party controls all three accounts, moving pooled funds through them to A-4989 (layering). The data records only device use, not ownership or identity.

The six identical 2500 credits to A-9895 from six senders on six devices may be a benign collection (for example a shared bill or group payment) rather than mule activity. They may also be a low-value test. Nothing in the data settles which.
The small amount kept back at each hop on A-9278's route (for example 138000 -> 135000 -> 132000) may be fees or cuts taken by intermediaries. That reading is not established.

unresolved.question: Who controls device D-568? Do A-9278, A-5092 and A-2897 belong to the same person? The dataset records device use only.

What happens to funds at A-4989 and A-1415 after this replay? Is A-1415's later T0055 (90000) funded by T0041 or by other money? The data has no onward link, and no events outside the bounded replay are available.
Do the senders to A-9278 (A-4452, A-4366, A-7266, A-8133, A-6801, A-3881) know each other, or are they victims? The data shows no shared device among them and no further relationship.
Was the 2500 still held at A-9895 (15000 received, 14000 passed on in T0041) spent later, outside this dataset?
